items.title: Earl Watkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 7, 2002
items.q: And from there he went to Charlie Spivak’s band

ctx.x: Boy that name has come up a lot, that place near Chicago where all the servicemen—

Camp Robert Smalls. And their ship’s company band was a dynamite band. Clark Terry was in it, Osie Johnson the drummer was in it, Willie Smith was in it for a short time. They say he got out on a Section 8 so I guess he put on a pretty good act. Yeah. And from there he went to Charlie Spivak’s band because the white bands were starting to integrate. So anyhow, at Great Lakes that’s when we got all the uniforms and everything and then the Chief, we had to learn how to march in formation, make your right turn, your…
turn, do your about face and we had one guy, a real tall handsome guy, they made him the band leader.
